desc: This Pattern was posted by themrsami. Tagged with: pattern, dark, black, 3D, abstract, hexagonal, geometric, cube, pattern, repeating, depth.
css:
.container {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(
      30deg,
      #111111 12%,
      transparent 12.5%,
      transparent 87%,
      #111111 87.5%,
      #111111
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      150deg,
      #111111 12%,
      transparent 12.5%,
      transparent 87%,
      #111111 87.5%,
      #111111
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      30deg,
      #111111 12%,
      transparent 12.5%,
      transparent 87%,
      #111111 87.5%,
      #111111
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      150deg,
      #111111 12%,
      transparent 12.5%,
      transparent 87%,
      #111111 87.5%,
      #111111
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      60deg,
      #77777777 25%,
      transparent 25.5%,
      transparent 75%,
      #77777777 75%,
      #77777777
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      60deg,
      #77777777 25%,
      transparent 25.5%,
      transparent 75%,
      #77777777 75%,
      #77777777
    );
  background-position:
    0 0,
    0 0,
    40px 70px,
    40px 70px,
    0 0,
    40px 70px;
  background-color: #000000;
  background-size: 80px 140px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.1);
}
